explanation: Nintendo dropped the deal in 1991 and signed with Philips instead. Sony carried on alone and launched the PlayStation in Japan in 1994.

claims.text: The PlayStation began as a CD-ROM add-on for Nintendo's Super Nintendo console, which Sony agreed in 1988 to develop with Nintendo.
Sony was not building the original add-on with Sega, Atari or Philips.
In 1991 Nintendo announced a CD-ROM partnership with Philips instead of Sony.
Sony launched the PlayStation in Japan in December 1994.
